description: Known, tested Home Assistant Bluetooth proxy — imported from the official esphome/bluetooth-proxies repo. New devices reference the upstream config as a remote package, picking up its updates on every build. The upstream config targets the v2.x hardware revision (IP101 Ethernet PHY); v1.0 units use a LAN8720 and need the ethernet block adjusted by hand.
name: GL.iNet GL-S10 v2 Bluetooth Proxy
